newsitem.title: FRANCE: Hollande named acting head of French Socialists.
newsitem.headline: Hollande named acting head of French Socialists.

text.p: France's governing Socialist party appointed Francois Hollande as acting leader on Wednesday now that its first secretary, Lionel Jospin, has become prime minister, party sources said.

Hollande, who was the Socialists' spokesman during the successful campaign for Sunday's parliamentary election, will hold the caretaker title of first secretary-delegate until a party congress later this year.

Hollande, 42, a member of the state Court of Auditors and political science lecturer, captured a parliamentary seat from the Gaullists on Sunday in President Jacques Chirac's fief of Correze in central France.
Hollande rose in politics as a follower of former European Commission president Jacques Delors, organising his supporters in two political clubs, Democratie 2000 and Club Temoin.

He is the companion of fellow Socialist parliamentarian Segolene Royal, who is expected to be a minister in the broad-left government to be announced later on Wednesday. The couple have four children.
